title: helm: stabilize private.values schema & init hooks to support upgrade/rollback
author: Priya Shah
release_notes: Stabilizes Private Helm values schema for smoother upgrades and adds idempotent init and rollback hooks to improve upgrade/rollback reliability.
description: Motivation: customers running Redwood Private reported upgrade failures when Helm values contained deprecated/unknown keys and when init jobs mutated cluster state non-idempotently. This PR tightens the values.schema.json, makes newer fields optional with clear defaults, and replaces the previous init job with an idempotent pre-upgrade job and a corresponding rollback hook that validates and reverts generated secrets/configmaps when an upgrade fails. Changes include schema validation, Helm templating tweaks, and small tests. Checklist: - [x] values.schema.json: add metadata, mark fields optional, deprecations documented; - [x] add pre-upgrade init Job with idempotent semantics and clear ownerReferences; - [x] add post-failure rollback hook that attempts safe revert only for resources created by the chart; - [x] helm unit & lint tests; - [x] e2e smoke deploy on kind. Related: Linear ENG-4762 (private upgrade reliability), ENG-4781 (helm chart hardening).
